value.sql:
"occ"."namespaces"."existing_namespace" IS NULL OR (
        char_length("occ"."namespaces"."existing_namespace") BETWEEN 1 AND 63
        AND "occ"."namespaces"."existing_namespace" ~ '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$'
      )

where.sql: "occ"."namespaces"."existing_namespace" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."namespaces"."deleted_at" IS NULL

value.sql:
char_length("occ"."secrets"."backend_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 253
        AND "occ"."secrets"."backend_key" ~ '^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]+$'
        AND "occ"."secrets"."backend_key" NOT IN ('.', '..')

"occ"."service_accounts"."credential" IS NULL OR (
        jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential") = 'object'
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" ?& ARRAY['kind', 'secretRef'])
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" - 'kind' - 'secretRef') = '{}'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->'kind') = 'string'
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->>'kind') IN ('api_key', 'oauth_access_token', 'access_token')
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->'secretRef') = 'object'
        AND (("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->'secretRef') ?& ARRAY['name', 'key'])
        AND (("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->'secretRef') - 'name' - 'key') = '{}'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #> '{secretRef,name}') = 'string'
        AND char_length("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,name}') BETWEEN 1 AND 253
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,name}') ~ '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*$'
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #> '{secretRef,key}') = 'string'
        AND char_length("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,key}') BETWEEN 1 AND 253
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,key}') ~ '^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]+$'
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,key}') NOT IN ('.', '..')
      )
